[EN] A lot of outsiders have been entering the Garden of the Sun lately. Researchers and explorers are welcome, but it looks like some of them are just thieves and fraudsters.
[ES] Muchos forasteros han estado entrando al Garden of the Sun últimamente. Los investigadores y exploradores son bienvenidos, pero parece que algunos de ellos son solo ladrones y estafadores.
